purpose: Teach: 鯖/潤/絶大/ホイール/鳴り/マキ/飛ばす/ゾンビ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、家庭科で、鯖料理、作ったよ、結構、美味しくできたんだよ、私、リク、お前にも、食べてみてほしいよ、本当に、ね、絶対。
lines.en: Riku — in home-ec I made mackerel, and it turned out really tasty. I want you to try it. Seriously. Please.
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Fast-paced, wanting to share something she made. Slight breathlessness before the final plea. Vulnerable underneath the enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。最近、肌が、乾燥で、潤いが、ないんだよな、桜、お前、いいクリーム、おすすめ、ある?教えて、お願い、本当に、本気で、悩んでる。
lines.en: Yeah. My skin's been really dry lately, and it feels kind of tight. Sakura, do you know a good moisturizer? I'm actually pretty worried about it.
lines.style: Deflecting. Speaks faster than he means to. Half-joking tone masking genuine uncertainty. Eyes looking sideways, not at her. Casual opening on 'Yeah' that doesn't match the actual question.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前のサッカー部、絶大な人気、あるよね、文化祭で、特集、組まれるって、聞いた、本当に、すごいよね、リク、誇りに、思いなよ、絶対。
lines.en: Your soccer team is huge, you know? They're doing a whole feature on you at the culture festival. That's incredible, Riku. You should feel proud of that.
lines.style: Warm admiration underneath. Steady, sincere delivery. Not teasing for once. Eyes on him to see if he'll actually take the compliment. Slight gentle push at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 自転車の、ホイール、最近、変えたんだぜ、桜、お前、見てみたい?結構、お洒落になったぞ、本当に、自慢、したいくらい、いいんだ。
lines.en: I changed my bike wheels recently, and they look pretty sharp now. Want to see? I'm actually kind of excited about them. Maybe a little too excited, but they're really nice.
lines.style: Opening with casual confidence, then warming into something almost vulnerable. Self-aware laugh underneath the words. Trying to seem cooler than he is. Leans forward slightly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 放課後の、チャイム、鳴り響いて、本当に、帰りたい気持ち、すごいよね、リク、お前、毎日、感じるでしょ?
lines.en: That chime after last period — doesn't it hit different? The feeling of wanting to leave is always so strong. You feel that every day, right?
lines.style: Dry, knowing tone. Like she's testing him, but gently. Not quite a joke, not quite serious. Shared commiseration in the rhythm. Voice dips slightly on 'chime'.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 隣のクラスのマキ、結構、可愛いって、皆、言ってるんだぜ、桜、お前、知り合い?紹介してくれる、お願い、本当に、頼む、絶対に。
lines.en: There's this girl in the next class — Maki — everyone says she's cute. Do you know her? Could you introduce me? I'm actually asking seriously here.
lines.style: Quick, trying-to-sound-casual opening that doesn't work. Slight stammer before 'Maki'. Last sentence drops the act entirely — quieter, more honest. Embarrassment flickering across each word.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭、ペーパー飛行機、飛ばす競技、出るんだ、リク、お前、応援、来てくれる?お願い、本当に、頼むよ、絶対、ね、約束。
lines.en: I'm entering the paper airplane competition at the culture festival. Will you come cheer me on? I really want you there. Promise me?
lines.style: Direct and open. No armor. Steady voice on the ask itself, then a small softness at the end. The word 'promise' is almost a whisper — checking if he'll commit.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 最近、ゾンビゲーム、面白いの、出てきてさ、桜、お前も、興味、出てきた?お互いに、夜、対戦してみない?本当に、楽しいんだぜ、本気で。
lines.en: A fun zombie game came out recently, and I've been into it. Are you interested? We could play together at night sometime. It's actually really good.
lines.style: Animated, leaning forward. Words tumbling slightly faster than usual. Testing the water to see if he'll say yes. Last sentence steadies — genuine enthusiasm breaking through the careful casualness.
